title: FinMentor Presents at FDIC Headquarters
excerpt: A delegation from the FinMentor Money Smart Organization — including its Board Chair, CEO, COO, and another student leader — presented at the headquarters of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) in Washington, D.C. During the visit, the delegation discussed the challenges of expanding FinMentor's reach with Assistant Director Ken Worthey and his colleagues, and sought their guidance and support for advancing financial education.
